title: HB0599 (114th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13, relative to firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2025-01-30; official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260513074212 of https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/114/Bill/HB0599.pdf (LegiScan doc 3092388))
provenance.note: Draft dated 2025-01-30; HB 599 and SB 34 share one document. No enactment indicated; adopted amendments, if any, not in text. Applies to transfers on or after July 1, 2025.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1316(s)): (1) It is an offense to knowingly give, sell, lend, deliver, or otherwise transfer a firearm to a person when the transferor knows or reasonably should know that the person receiving the firearm is prohibited from purchasing or possessing a firearm under state or federal law.
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1316(s)): (2) A violation of this subsection (s) is a Class A misdemeanor.
